notes.title: Tile Dynasty Update - June 2017
notes.content:
Hello there!

We're now coming around our final leg of development, and the estimated roadmap from here will take us a couple more months of development to wrap up some key outstanding features for the Early Access release.:

Finalized map
Finalized Home Base as an interactive Local Lobby to setup Games from there
Coop game play experience
Online game play experience

The game play experience will feature verticality and explosions that'll fling you into combat action! So make sure to watch your six!

With this as our next features to focus on, we hope to be more in touch with the community and have more updates rolling from here on out. - So please stay tuned!


Cheers!!
